thread:
Mina: heads-up: saw steady memory climb on a long-chat workload. big fragments (>64k) are persisting and the overall KV footprint grows over time. thinking we need fragment-size telemetry and reuse signals.
Raj: can you paste the logs/traces you saw? a small sample + promql would help.
Mina: pasted below (truncated):
Mina: ```
[2026-03-16T09:12:03Z] evict: frag=0x7f3 size=74240 residency_ms=3200000 reason=age
[2026-03-16T09:12:03Z] evict: frag=0x7f9 size=32768 residency_ms=42000 reason=usage
[2026-03-16T09:12:04Z] alloc: frag=0x8b2 size=131072 new=true
```
Mina: quick PromQL I used to eyeball: 
Mina: ```promql
sum by (bucket) (rate(kv_cache_evictions_total[5m]))
(sum by (bucket) (kv_cache_residency_seconds_sum) / sum by (bucket) (kv_cache_residency_seconds_count))
```
Olivia: how are you defining buckets? suggest: lt16k, 16-64k, 64-256k, gt256k.
Mina: implemented those labels in the runtime: frag_bucket=... when we emit alloc/evict/residency. also added eviction_reason label (age/usage/compact/oom).
Raj: nice. do we have reuse metrics? big frags might never be reused for short prompts. we should record alloc_count and reuse_count by bucket.
Mina: added kv_cache_alloc_total{frag_bucket} and kv_cache_reuse_total{frag_bucket}. reuse_rate = rate(kv_cache_reuse_total[5m]) / rate(kv_cache_alloc_total[5m]).
Jules: also think about tagging allocs with session length bin (short/med/long) so we can correlate long-context sessions with large-frag allocations.
Mina: added session_len_bin label (<512,512-2048,>2048 tokens). that lets us slice reuse by bucket+session_len_bin.
SRE Oncall: for alerts, propose: gt64k bucket median residency > 1h OR eviction rate for gt256k rising > 5x baseline. also alert on sudden drop in reuse_rate for gt256k.
Olivia: dashboard panels I want: 1) residency p50/p90 by frag_bucket over time, 2) eviction rate split by reason+bucket, 3) reuse_rate heatmap (prompt-length vs frag_bucket), 4) memory contribution by bucket. keep panels compact.
Mina: sample panel queries I plan to add:
Mina: ```promql
# P90 residency per bucket (10m window)
histogram_quantile(0.9, sum by (le, frag_bucket) (rate(kv_cache_residency_seconds_bucket[10m])))

# eviction rate by reason & bucket
sum by (eviction_reason, frag_bucket) (rate(kv_cache_evictions_total[5m]))

# approximate memory footprint by bucket
sum by (frag_bucket) (kv_cache_fragment_bytes_total)
```
Raj: beware cardinality explosion from labels. sampling is necessary.
Jules: agreed. we should emit sampled counters for alloc/reuse (sample_rate label) and keep histograms unsampled for residency. suggest default sample 1/100 at high QPS and expose kv_cache_sample_rate per instance.
Mina: implemented sample_rate label and kv_cache_sample_rate gauge. kept residency histograms unsampled. also bounded frag_bucket and session_len_bin label cardinality.
Olivia: runtime-bot just kicked off a canary: runtime/kv-frag-metrics -> canary (3 nodes) by Mina at 2026-03-16T18:04:00Z.
Mina: starting the long-chat-runner on canary for 6h to reproduce the memory trend; will attach grafana links in #eng-runtime-dashboards when available.
SRE Oncall: please add alert rules: 1) reuse_rate drop > 50% for gt256k over 10m; 2) memory-by-bucket growth > 20% in 15m; 3) eviction_rate spike for age evictions in gt64k. tune thresholds in staging.
Raj: will draft alert rules and test against staging telemetry tomorrow.
Jules: I'll audit the sampling math and ensure we can extrapolate counts without blowing prometheus cardinality. also check if we should histogram fragment sizes for more granular insight.
Mina: ACTIONS: PR dashboard + prometheus rules (Mina), alerts tuning (Raj), sampling review (Jules), run results + grafana links (Olivia). I'll open the PR and tag reviewers.
Olivia: nice focused telemetry plan. thanks Mina :thumbsup:
Mina: thanks everyone. will post links and canary run summary in this thread.
